gen-dafont-starborn-gf-khula: Spacious, dreamy lettering: Starborn leaves wide gaps between letters and lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. Khula has a tall midsection and open-mouthed curves, so paragraphs go down smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-krub: Wide-spaced and dreamy, Starborn drifts across the line. Its dark lowercase stripe is what it does best, while Krub does quiet legibility with a pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-lexend: Dreamy and spaced out, Starborn puts big gaps between letters and a dark stripe of lowercase through each line. Lexend, with outsized lowercase and open-jawed curves, keeps text approachable and easy to follow down the page.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-nata-sans: Starry and spaced out: Starborn leaves wide gaps between letters, with a thick, dark stripe of lowercase. Nata Sans has a large central band and wide-mouthed curves drawn with technical-pen steadiness, so text reads smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans: Spacious, hushed lettering: Starborn pairs big gaps between letters with a thick, dark stripe of lowercase. But Noto Sans, with lowercase filling most of the letter height and a generously open c, grounds it with quiet clarity.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Starborn does the dreaming, with wide gaps and a dark lowercase stripe, while the body font stands tall and full.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Ethereal and spaced out, Starborn lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line with wide gaps between letters. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined stays modern, with almost no height difference between cases.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-balines: Noto Sans Balinese gives every curved glyph breathing space. Starborn is the showpiece, with wide gaps between letters and a dark lowercase stripe, while the body font stays modern with short ascenders.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Contemporary meets ethereal: Starborn drifts, Noto Sans Bengali stays put. Most striking is the difference, a dark lowercase stripe with wide gaps up top against capitals barely taller than lowercase with open mouths below.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-carian: Clean as open scissor blades, Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart beside Starborn, which has wide gaps and a dark stripe. One drifts, the other holds the lines steady.
